originalBehavior: The published Get started lesson boots the Learning Synths shell, loads the RNBO-backed synth runtime, and drops straight into a playable XY pad.
localStatus: The local route keeps that lesson shell and RNBO runtime from shared scripts with route-local lesson assets while adding a family-scoped field-guide boundary and shared Atlas chrome.
notes: The archive preserves the published runtime rather than rebuilding the synth pad in a custom stack.
The route forces the stable low-quality audio mode at boot so the archived lesson can mount consistently from local assets.
The additive family treatment changes only the outer lesson boundary and shared chrome; the archived synth controls remain runtime-owned.
evidence: Music smoke coverage verifies local script loading, family metadata, chrome alignment, the XY control update path, and note-trigger state changes on the shipped route.
The rendered lesson body rewrites localizable chapter links to shipped local synth routes after the React shell mounts.

originalBehavior: The published lesson relies on shared Learning Synths fonts, text payloads, RNBO patch data, models, and lesson WAV files around the main synth surface.
localStatus: The local route archives those first-party assets under its own tree so the synth lesson can run without remote media fetches.
notes: The archived inventory includes 12 font files, 4 shared sound assets, 5 lesson WAVs, 4 GLB models, 6 text payload JSON files, 2 preset catalogs, and 1 RNBO patch.
Route-local assets are served from relative paths for GitHub Pages subpath hosting.
evidence: Music smoke coverage asserts the expected local asset counts before interaction checks begin.
The route passes the no-remote-playable-media check inside the music smoke group.

originalBehavior: The published lesson lets users drag across an XY synth surface to change sound and trigger notes immediately.
localStatus: The local route keeps the playable XY pad and its note-trigger state while routing chapter navigation and provenance through local-only surfaces.
notes: The first synth lesson is treated as the family bootstrap and the smoke gate for the playable XY surface.
The shipped route preserves the lesson heading, chapter handoff, and in-body synth interaction instead of condensing the page into a custom wrapper.
evidence: Music smoke coverage verifies the XY control position changes and that the route enters and exits the note-trigger state cleanly.
The public shell stays responsive on narrow viewports and retains footer-only provenance after the lesson mounts.

originalBehavior: The lesson initializes the shared Learning Synths runtime before mounting its playable Get started scene.
localStatus: The app mount is the named runtime main with loading text; successful initialization clears busy state, while unsupported browsers and initialization failures replace it with a concise status message.
notes: The shared lesson runtime and XY interaction remain unchanged.
All terminal loading paths clear the busy state.
evidence: Focused browser coverage verifies successful mount, unsupported-browser messaging, and initialization failure handling.
Phase 10 source and browser contracts require one meaningful runtime main.

originalBehavior: The published lesson follows the operating-system color scheme, preserves Ableton typography and runtime tokens, and opens localized chapter navigation from its native table-of-contents control.
localStatus: The declared `#app[data-ableton-synth-lesson]` runtime hook maps stored light and dark themes onto the archived token set, preserves the React/RNBO XY scene and dimensions, and keeps the native lesson drawer keyboard-operated.
notes: The adapter maps only existing custom-property hooks; intrinsic SVG, canvas, model, and audio output remain runtime-owned.
The visible native TOC toggle owns navigation; opening exposes localized lesson links, while Escape closes the drawer and restores focus.
evidence: Strict experience gates verify stored and system themes, runtime-root contrast, local-only networking, and unchanged approved runtime geometry.
Family smoke verifies XY and held-note state, local asset inventories, native TOC focus behavior, localized links, responsive layout, and footer-only provenance.

originalBehavior: The Route keeps its authored top-level document, runtime roots, and script order.
localStatus: Manifest synchronization owns the body Engineering Sandbox metadata and shared head seams while preserving Route runtime placement.
notes: Ticket 12 synchronizes the manifest-owned Engineering Sandbox body contract and shared head seams without moving existing Route runtimes or scripts.
evidence: Route HTML declares canonical data-story metadata plus one color-scheme meta, synchronous theme init before Route styles, Sandbox CSS after Route styles, and one deferred Sandbox runtime whose existing position is preserved.
